title: Yatidharmaprakāśa

scholarly.text: early modern; date uncertain

title: Upaniṣad Brahmayogin's commentaries on the 108 Upaniṣads

scholarly.text: 18th c. CE, Kāñcīpuram

title: Nārāyaṇa's Dīpikās on the Upaniṣads
summary: Brief glosses (dīpikā) by a commentator named Nārāyaṇa on many Atharvan and minor Upaniṣads, including texts outside the Muktikā list; used by Colebrooke's and later catalogues to define an 'Atharvan' list of 52.

scholarly.text: medieval; date uncertain

title: Jīvanmuktiviveka
